title: Titanium TAVI Frame
alloyReason: Nitinol (Nickel-Titanium Shape Memory Alloy, ASTM F2063) provides unique superelasticity and shape memory effect, enabling self-expanding stents, kink-resistant guidewires, and deployable medical devices. Its elastic recoverable strain (up to 8%) is orders of magnitude higher than any conventional metal.
commonFailures: Surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (ASTM F86)

faq.q: What is a titanium tavi frame?
faq.a: A titanium tavi frame is a precision-machined cardiovascular component used in transcatheter aortic valve replacement frame (nitinol). Manufactured from Nitinol (ASTM F2063) for optimal strength, corrosion resistance, and weight savings.

faq.q: What is the typical application for titanium tavi frame?
faq.a: Titanium TAVI Frame is designed for transcatheter aortic valve replacement frame (nitinol). The Nitinol (ASTM F2063) grade is selected to provide the optimal balance of strength, fatigue life, and environmental resistance for this specific application.

faq.q: How is titanium tavi frame manufactured?
faq.a: Titanium TAVI Frame is manufactured using Laser micro-cutting. Critical process controls include tool path optimization, coolant temperature management, and dimensional verification at each operation.

faq.q: What is the most common issue with titanium tavi frame?
faq.a: The most common issue is surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (astm f86). Mitigation includes proper process control, material certification, and adherence to recommended installation procedures and torque values.

faq.q: What is the lead time for titanium tavi frame?
faq.a: Standard lead time: 2-4 weeks depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders available. Contact our team with your drawing and quantity for an accurate delivery quote.
